description: AlphaFold model of human PLPBP: test clustering of cross-kingdom invariant residues around the K47 PLP attachment site
code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/O94903",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=90).text
print("model:", meta["modelEntityId"], "v", meta["latestVersion"], "global pLDDT", meta["globalMetricValue"])
atoms=[]
for l in pdb.split("\n"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        atoms.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),num=int(l[22:26]),
                          x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),b=float(l[60:66])))
print("atoms",len(atoms))
plddt={}
for a in atoms: plddt.setdefault(a['num'],a['b'])
nums=sorted(plddt); pl=np.array([plddt[i] for i in nums])
print("mean pLDDT core 1-250 = {:.1f}; tail 251-275 = {:.1f}; N-term 1-15 = {:.1f}".format(
    pl[:250].mean(), pl[250:].mean(), pl[:15].mean()))

nz=[a for a in atoms if a['num']==47 and a['name']=='NZ'][0]
c=np.array([nz['x'],nz['y'],nz['z']])
dmin={}
for a in atoms:
    d=float(np.linalg.norm(np.array([a['x'],a['y'],a['z']])-c))
    dmin[a['num']]=min(dmin.get(a['num'],1e9),d)
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
rn={a['num']:aa3[a['res']] for a in atoms}
pocket=sorted([n for n,d in dmin.items() if d<10.0])
print("\nPocket (within 10 A of K47 NZ), n={}:".format(len(pocket)))
print("  "+", ".join(rn[n]+str(n) for n in pocket))

invariant=[47,67,92,95,98,179,181,222,224,228,241,243]
print("\nDistance of each strictly invariant residue to K47 NZ:")
for i in invariant: print("   {}{:<4d} {:5.1f} A".format(rn[i],i,dmin[i]))
inpk=[i for i in invariant if dmin[i]<10.0]
d_inv=[dmin[i] for i in invariant]; d_rest=[dmin[i] for i in nums if i not in invariant]
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(d_inv,d_rest,alternative='less')
ph=stats.hypergeom.sf(len(inpk)-1,len(nums),len(pocket),len(invariant))
print("\n{}/{} invariant residues lie within 10 A of K47 NZ (background {}/{} residues)".format(
    len(inpk),len(invariant),len(pocket),len(nums)))
print("Hypergeometric p = {:.2e}".format(ph))
print("Mann-Whitney U = {:.0f}, p = {:.2e}; median distance invariant {:.1f} A vs other {:.1f} A".format(
    u,p,np.median(d_inv),np.median(d_rest)))

# disease residues
dis={87:'P',175:'L',241:'R'}
print("\nEPEO1 missense residues: distance to K47 NZ")
for i in dis: print("   {}{:<4d} {:5.1f} A".format(rn[i],i,dmin[i]))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.2))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(nums,pl,color="#4C78A8",lw=1.2)
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",color="grey",lw=0.8)
ax.axvspan(251,275,color="grey",alpha=0.25); ax.text(263,40,"disordered\nC-tail",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="grey")
ax.set_xlabel("Residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("AlphaFold confidence for human PLPBP")
ax=axes[1]
bins=np.linspace(0,max(d_rest),30)
ax.hist(d_rest,bins=bins,color="#BAB0AC",label="other residues (n={})".format(len(d_rest)))
ax.hist(d_inv,bins=bins,color="#D62728",label="invariant residues (n=12)")
ax.set_xlabel("Minimum distance to K47 NZ (angstrom)"); ax.set_ylabel("Residues")
ax.set_title("Invariant residues cluster at the PLP site\nMann-Whitney p = {:.1e}".format(p))
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
